# QuarterScore

> QuarterScore is a free website for running football squares (also called Super Bowl squares) online. A host makes a 100, 50 or 25 square board and shares one link, friends claim squares by typing a name, and live scores pick the winner of each quarter. QuarterScore never collects, holds, or pays out money.

Site: https://quarterscore.com/

Key facts:

- Free to use. Creating a board and claiming squares costs nothing.
- QuarterScore never collects, holds, or pays out money. Most groups play for bragging rights.
- Players do not need an account. They open the link and type a name on a square. Only the host signs in, to save and run the board.
- Boards come in 100, 50 or 25 squares.
- A board is shared by one link or a six-character game code. Games are not listed in a public directory.
- Squares update in real time for everyone on the board.
- The host locks the board, then the digits 0 through 9 are drawn at random for the rows and the columns, so nobody picks a digit.
- Quarter winners are found automatically from the last digit of each team's score.
- Boards can follow a live game: the score and clock come from ESPN, for NFL, NCAA football, UFL, NBA, WNBA and AFL games. Any other game works as a custom board with your own team names.
- Points split 20, 20, 20 and 40 percent across the four quarters as standard. These are points, never money.
- If a quarter's winning square is empty, the host chooses whether its points roll into the final quarter or are shared across the other quarters.
- Hosts can mark players as checked in or paid, add a co-host, and leave a short note on the board.
- TV mode puts the board, live score, quarter winners and a QR code to join on a big screen. It can rotate through several boards every 10 to 60 seconds, and Copy TV link opens it on any screen with no sign-in.
- A printable blank 10 by 10 grid and a PDF are free to download.
- The Best numbers page and the Hit rate tab show how often each last-digit pair has come up in historical scoring.
- In that history the most common last-digit pairs (away, home) are 7 and 0 (3.5%), 0 and 7 (3.4%), 4 and 7 (2.9%), 7 and 4 (2.9%), 0 and 3 (2.8%). History is not a promise about any one game.

## Guides

- [How to play football squares](https://quarterscore.com/how-to-play): How to play football squares: 100, 50, or 25 squares, numbers drawn after the board fills, and a winner each quarter from the last digit of each score.
- [Football squares FAQ](https://quarterscore.com/faq): Football squares FAQ: cost, accounts, how numbers are drawn, private games, overtime, unfilled boards, and whether QuarterScore handles money.
- [Super Bowl squares](https://quarterscore.com/super-bowl-squares): Super Bowl squares for Super Bowl LXI on February 14, 2027. Make a free board before the teams are set and share one link with friends.
- [Thanksgiving football squares](https://quarterscore.com/thanksgiving-football-squares): Football squares for Thanksgiving: a free board for the table, one game or three, with a link guests can open between dinner and dessert.
- [NFL squares](https://quarterscore.com/nfl-squares): NFL squares on a free 10 by 10 board. Share a link, claim squares by name, and follow each quarter without a spreadsheet.
- [NFL playoff squares](https://quarterscore.com/nfl-playoff-squares): NFL playoff squares for wild card weekend, the divisional round, and the conference championships. One free board per game, same link style all January.
- [College football squares](https://quarterscore.com/college-football-squares): College football squares for bowl games and the playoff. Create a free NCAA board, share one link, and score each quarter from the last digits.
- [Donation squares](https://quarterscore.com/football-squares-fundraiser): Donation-style football squares for a school, team, or charity. Free to claim, optional donations, and nothing of value for players. QuarterScore never handles the money.
- [NBA squares](https://quarterscore.com/nba-squares): NBA squares uses the same last-digit board as football. Create a free basketball game, share the link, and follow each quarter.
- [Football squares on TV](https://quarterscore.com/football-squares-on-tv): Show your football squares board on a TV or big screen with QuarterScore TV mode: the board, the score, each quarter winner and a QR code to join.

## Tools

- [Create a free board](https://quarterscore.com/create): Set up a 100, 50 or 25 square board. The host signs in when the board is saved.
- [Best squares numbers](https://quarterscore.com/best-squares-numbers): How often each last-digit pair has shown up in historical scoring.
- [Printable football squares](https://quarterscore.com/printable-football-squares): A free blank 10 by 10 grid, a print view and a PDF.
- [Football squares by NFL team](https://quarterscore.com/teams): A board page for each of the 32 NFL teams.
